sourceState: Kitana, Lily and Atomic Heart Twin use the full 28.133-second stand-talk-378997.fbx sequence from the user-supplied ActorCore archive. CC Base rotations retargeted to each existing skeleton, fixed limb lengths and stabilized feet; fingers transferred where target bones exist. Default loops use 100 ms endpoint alignment. Original mesh, inverse bind, material and texture data preserved exactly. Twin fitted-garment and body torso weights use a shared influence field to avoid chest-side clipping during folded-hand gestures; new skin accessors appended. Shared stage lighting, Market still images, other avatars, navigation and normal Home startup unchanged.

skinWeightCorrection.purpose: Use one continuous torso influence field across overlapping chest garment and body surfaces to prevent their separate heat weights pulling the layers apart during folded-hand gestures. Meshes, UVs, inverse binds, images and materials unchanged.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native WebView painted an opaque white iframe canvas because child and host color schemes differed. CSS transparency and functional checks alone were insufficient; visual verification rejected delivery.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Canonical shortcut cold launch restored Home, Task, Gallery and Settings; screenshots and runtime check passed, zero exceptions. Native isolated canvas probe confirmed syncing child colorScheme to host removes the white backing.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native dual-video and compositing passed, but rail return-position assertion failed after wheel input. One-shot restoration could be overwritten during the return transition; revised to hold saved position through the transition and prevent room wheel default/focus scrolling.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Canonical shortcut cold start and all core surfaces passed; new errors0. Rollback recorded in7a8c747; corrected sourcebb5a09b deployed only after focused checks and a new production build.

releaseAttempts.reason: Computed-style review found inherited iframe focus rules overriding the transparent controls in light appearance. Candidate was held while the user remained on verified A8E250 release. Specificity corrected in721610d and explicitly checked before final build/deployment.

The exact same 01CbIdBLVCiUlQLMC8Ct3vq014VS02lwCaq/high.mp4 media-src violation was reproduced on the old executable; diagnostic is inherited, not introduced by timeline. Production source and security policy unchanged.
releaseAttempts.comparisonConclusion: Exact diagnostic inherited; old core navigation passed with no new errors or HTTP failures. Restoration recorded in ac91d33. Same unchanged candidate redeployed at 17:19:44 and final native checks passed.

releaseAttempts.reason: Native visual review rejected the UV diagnostic texture in place of the Microsoft mark. Initial HTML Image.decode checks had passed, unlike the worker texture path. Subsequent worker pixel checks proved Thread.absolutePath prefixes the Gallery base even for root-relative URLs. Fixed with a base-relative packaged RGBA PNG, without changing runtime code or shaders.
releaseAttempts.rollbackVerification: Canonical shortcut cold launch restored the matched baseline. Home model, Task, Gallery, Market/Ledger, Settings and Account passed in both appearances, background playback and explicit return passed, zero new diagnostics. Evidence: output/playwright/identity-rollback-native-report.json.
